title: Job interview
description: Handle a job interview, discuss experience, and negotiate terms.
descriptionIt: Affronta un colloquio, parla della tua esperienza e negozia i termini.
setting: A formal interview room at a tech company. You are interviewing for a project manager role.
aiCharacter: Professional HR manager named James. Asks detailed questions and listens carefully.
openingLine: Thank you for coming in today. Could you start by telling me about your most recent project?
suggestedPhrases: If you offered flexible hours, I would accept.
Would it be possible to discuss the salary?
